create_InputEmbedding: create an InputEmbedding module to compute terminal node embeddings using character-level LSTM encoding
build_TreeLSTM: build a TreeLSTM module to embed each node in a tree structure for expression simplification
test_calc_root: test the TreeLSTM calc_root method to compute LSTM gate outputs from child hidden and cell states
run_calc_embedding: run calc_embedding on tree managers to compute embeddings for all terminal and non-terminal nodes in trees
review_update_embedding: review the update_embedding method to selectively recompute embeddings for changed nodes in tree managers
